about: One row per place the plugin must read or change Silksong. gameTarget is the real class/method to patch and stays null until found by reading the game's code; every null is a preflight finding. 'core' in usedBy means the run loop itself needs it.

rows.name: onPlayerDeath
rows.purpose: Intercept death: end the run, or let Second Wind prevent it.

rows.name: onRoomEnter
rows.purpose: Know when Hornet enters a room (resets per-room effects).

rows.name: startNewRun
rows.purpose: Reset world and player state, roll a loadout, equip it.

rows.name: damageDealt
rows.purpose: Modify damage Hornet deals; count hits.

rows.name: damageTaken
rows.purpose: Modify or negate damage Hornet takes.

rows.name: spawnLoot
rows.purpose: Roll and spawn a loot pickup when an enemy dies.

rows.name: runSaveSlot
rows.purpose: Keep run state in its own save slot so the player's real save is never overwritten.

rows.name: showRunMessage
rows.purpose: Show 'Run started: <loadout>' and 'Found: <item>' text on screen.
